name: Cannabicyclohexanol
summary: Cannabicyclohexanol (CCH, CP 47,497 dimethyloctyl homologue, (C8)-CP 47,497) is a cannabinoid receptor agonist drug, developed by Pfizer in 1979. On 19 January 2009, the University of Freiburg in Germany announced that an analog of CP 47,497 was the main active ingredient in the herbal incense product Spice, specifically the 1,1-dimethyloctyl homologue of CP 47,497, which is now known as cannabicyclohexanol.

pharmacology.text: Cannabicyclohexanol (CCH, CP 47,497 dimethyloctyl homologue, (C8)-CP 47,497) is a cannabinoid receptor agonist drug, developed by Pfizer in 1979.

uses.text: Cannabicyclohexanol (CCH, CP 47,497 dimethyloctyl homologue, (C8)-CP 47,497) is a cannabinoid receptor agonist drug, developed by Pfizer in 1979.

summaryZh: 大麻環己醇（英語：Cannabicyclohexanol，縮寫CCH，也稱為-CP 47,497，化學名：2-[-3-羥基環己基]-5-(1,1-二甲基辛基)苯酚，2-[-3-hydroxycyclohexyl]-5-phenol）是一種有機化合物，分子式C22H36O2，屬於人工合成的大麻素，與CP 47,497是同系物，1979年由輝瑞公司開發。
summaryZhHans: 大麻环己醇（英语：Cannabicyclohexanol，缩写CCH，也称为-CP 47,497，化学名：2-[-3-羟基环己基]-5-(1,1-二甲基辛基)苯酚，2-[-3-hydroxycyclohexyl]-5-phenol）是一种有机化合物，分子式C22H36O2，属于人工合成的大麻素，与CP 47,497是同系物，1979年由辉瑞公司开发。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis, seizures and kidney injury, and their effects are often stronger and less predictable than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀、癲癇發作與腎臟損傷，作用往往比大麻更強、更難預測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状、癫痫发作与肾脏损伤，作用往往比大麻更强、更难预测。

fact.en: Pfizer made it in 1979 while searching for new painkillers. Decades later, in 2009, its discovery in Spice showed that "herbal incense" sold as natural plant blends was in fact sprayed with synthetic cannabinoids.
fact.zh: 輝瑞在 1979 年尋找新型止痛藥時合成了它。數十年後的 2009 年，它在 Spice 中被檢出，揭露了以天然植物混合物名義販售的「草本薰香」其實噴灑了合成大麻素。
fact.zhHans: 辉瑞在 1979 年寻找新型止痛药时合成了它。数十年后的 2009 年，它在 Spice 中被检出，揭露了以天然植物混合物名义贩售的「草本薰香」其实喷洒了合成大麻素。
